subject: Allow null in SENTINEL GET-PRIMARY-ADDR-BY-NAME reply schema (#5246)
reason: The diff only changes the reply_schema metadata in the sentinel-get-primary-addr-by-name.json and sentinel-get-master-addr-by-name.json command definition files (to document that a null reply is valid for an unknown primary) and adds a Tcl regression test. The server's reply code in src/sentinel.c is untouched: it already returned a null array for an unknown primary on both the parent and the change. reply_schema is not compiled into commands.def or the server binary, so no runtime behaviour differs between the two builds; there is nothing a scenario could reach or compare.
